scenes.heading: Finding creators to work with the right way

sents.d: Finding creators to work with the right way
A track record and a specific, honest pitch matter more than volume of outreach.

Cold outreach to creators works best when it's specific and honest about what you offer and what results are realistic — vague promises of guaranteed massive income are a common tactic of low-quality 'agencies' and will damage your credibility with anyone experienced.
Building a small track record with one or two clients first, even at a modest scale, gives you real numbers and a genuine case study to reference rather than only theoretical promises.
Referrals from creators you've worked well with are typically a much stronger source of new clients than cold outreach, since trust transfers from someone the prospective client already knows.

take: Pitch honestly, prove results with a few clients, then grow by referral.
